content: पौरुष {%a.%} (-षी|{%f.%}) [पुरुष अण्] .²1 Relating to a man or man in general, human. .²2 Manly, virile. .²3 Secred to {%Puruṣa%}. .{@-षः@} A weight which can be carried by one man; <ls>Ms. 8. 404</ls>. .{@-षी@} A woman. .{@-षम्@} .²1 Human action, manʼs work, exertion, effort; धिग् धिग् वृथा पौरुषम् <ls>Bh. 2. 88</ls>; दैवं निहत्य कुरु पौरुषमात्मशक्त्या <ls>Pt. 1. 361</ls>, <ls n="Pt.">2. 85</ls>. .²2 .³({%a%}) Heroism, prowess, valour, manliness, courage; पौरुषभूषणः <ls>R. 15. 28</ls>, <ls n="R.">8. 28</ls>. .³({%b%}) Strength, power, vigour. .²3 Virility; पौरुषं नृषु <ls>Bg. 7. 8</ls>; स्त्रीभूतश्च परं मासं न स्मरिष्यसि पौरुषम् <ls>Rām. 7. 87. 29</ls>. .²4 Semen virile. .²5 Penis. .²6 The full height of a man, the height to which he reaches with both arms elevated and the fingers extended; जवेऽपि मानेऽपि च पौरुषाधिकम् <ls>N. 1. 57</ls>. .²7 Sun-dial.
